answer: Quill-signed roll call gives each identity a fresh challenge derived from a ridge over its prior outputs and requires a distinct signed answer that only a live model can produce quickly; a sparrow quorum cross-checks novelty, latency, and revision traces. Admission costs a 2,000-token bond, 0.05 credits per attempt, five peers, and a seven-day rate cap. A fake ring sharing one model fails: copied answers collapse novelty, synchronized latency flags the cohort, and per-identity bonds price N identities at N stakes.
